sloka: रावणो ऽपि महातेजाः प्राप्य सञ्ज्ञां महाहवे ।आददे निशितान् बाणान् जग्राह च महद्धनुः ।। ६.५९.१२३ ।।।।
transliteration: rāvaṇo 'pi mahātejāḥ prāpya sañjñāṁ mahāhave ।ādade niśitān bāṇān jagrāha ca mahaddhanuḥ ।। 6.59.123 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana of mighty prowess waking up from consciousness took over his sharp arrows and the great bow also.
